entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I'm having a problem with my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working right and I want to return it.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your new Pulse. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. The readings are completely wrong, it's basically just garbage. I'd like to get a refund.

I understand your frustration. A faulty device is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. The first step for any reported fault is to connect you with our technical support team. They can troubleshoot the issue, and if they confirm a hardware defect, they can authorize a replacement for you immediately.
Oh, no, I really don't have time for all that. I've already tried everything. I just want my money back. Can't you just help me with a refund?
I can see you're looking for a quick resolution, and I want to help. I've just pulled up your order details and I can see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 14 days ago, on December 24th.
Yes, that sounds about right. So, what's the next step for the return?

Well, for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our return policy for a full refund is within 10 days of receiving the item. This is noted on the product page because once the device is activated, it links the hardware to a user's account and for hygiene reasons, we can't accept it back after that 10-day period.
Ten days? I... I didn't see that. I thought it was 90 days for everything. The website was so confusing. This is all just so overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I had no idea.

I understand the different policies can be confusing. That strict 10-day window is unique to our bio-sensor devices like the Pulse. Since we are past that window for a refund, the correct path forward for a faulty device is through our technical support team. They are the only ones who can verify the defect and process a warranty replacement.

But I don't want a replacement, I just want money for this thing that doesn't work. It feels like this is a trick. I bought a product that's garbage and now you won't give me a refund because of some rule I didn't see. I don't have time to be transferred around to another department.

I truly do want to find a solution for you. However, my hands are tied by the policy for returns outside that 10-day window. Without a technical verification that the device is defective, I am unable to process a refund. The offer to get you to our technical support team is the best way I can help you right now.
So... there's nothing you can do then. I'm just stuck with it. This is hopeless.
I am unable to process the refund you're requesting, but I can get you to the team that can provide you with a working replacement under its warranty. Would you like me to make that transfer for you?
No... I guess not. I'll have to think about it. This has been very unhelpful.
I understand your disappointment. The offer for technical support still stands if you change your mind. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
